title: Dicoccous
summary: DICOCCOUS, adjective [Gr., Latin , a grain.] Two-grained; consisting of two cohering grains or cells, with one seed in each; as a dicoccous capsule.

inlines.v: DICOCCOUS, adjective [Gr., Latin , a grain.] Two-grained; consisting of two cohering grains or cells, with one seed in each; as a dicoccous capsule.
